qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Artisan capacity bottlenecks, multi-year waitlists for iconic Birkin and Kelly bags, and multi-generational French leathercrafting heritage create an unreplicable luxury moat. Returns protected by refusing volume growth beyond artisan training capacity (~7% annual volume cap). Proved by 70%+ GAAP ROIC and >40% recurring operating margins through all macro cycles. Primary erosion risks are counterfeit proliferation and potential over-commercialization of non-leather categories.

Birkin and Kelly waitlists and artisan capacity limits preserve scarcity and >40% EBIT margins. Fortress balance sheet with >€12B net cash. qualitative.evidence: FY2025 revenue reached €16,002M (+9% cFX) with recurring operating margin of 41.0% (€6,569M). 5-year GAAP ROIC exceeds 70% (median 96%). Balance sheet holds €12,239M in cash against only €34M long-term debt, yielding over €12B in net cash. Owner FCF conversion exceeds 90% (€4.3B FCF in FY25). Family-controlled ownership structure ensures multi-generational discipline.
